List operators, user, method and indirect calls, and niladic builtins
written by precedence (issue 01a1692f-65de-750b-aac5-f2506623ec7f). Canon
writes a call bare where the source wrote it bare, with call parens where
the source wrote `NAME(` (ArgParen) or where the operator after it is
tighter than a list operator. A niladic builtin or compile-time token is its
bare name. A trailing comma right before an operator ends the list there,
and that call stays bare. Each snippet's Deparse,-p is perl 5.44.0's.

=== push before a looser or
push @a, 1 or die;
--- facts
faithful
# (push(@a, 1) or die);

=== print before a looser and
print $x, 1 and f();
--- facts
faithful
# (print($x, 1) and f());

=== a user call as the last argument of another
sub foo; sub bar; foo 1, bar 2, 3;
--- facts
faithful
# foo(1, bar(2, 3));
# sub bar ;
# sub foo ;

=== indirect object call, bare
package Foo; sub new {1} package main; new Foo "a";
--- facts
faithful
# package Foo;
# sub new {
#     1;
# }
# package main;
# 'Foo'->new('a');

=== indirect object call with its parens
package Foo; sub new {1} package main; new Foo("a");
--- facts
faithful
# package Foo;
# sub new {
#     1;
# }
# package main;
# 'Foo'->new('a');

=== indirect object call on a core class
find PerlIO::Layer 'perlio';
--- facts
faithful
# 'PerlIO::Layer'->find('perlio');

=== print with a block filehandle
print {$fh} "x";
--- facts
faithful
# print({$fh;} 'x');

=== print with a scalar filehandle and a list
print $fh @list;
--- facts
faithful
# print($fh @list);

=== sort with a comparator block
my @s = sort { $a <=> $b } @a;
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@s) = (sort {$a <=> $b} @a));

=== sort with a named comparator
my @s = sort foo @a;
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@s) = (sort foo @a));

=== sort over a named unary
my %h; my @s = sort keys %h;
--- facts
faithful
# my(%h);
# (my(@s) = sort(keys(%h)));

=== print with source parens before a comma
print ($a), $b;
--- facts
faithful
# (print($a), $b);

=== print with source parens
print("x");
--- facts
faithful
# print('x');

=== time, bare
my $t = time;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($t) = time);

=== time with its own parens
my $t = time();
--- facts
faithful
# (my($t) = time);

=== time before a tighter plus
my $t = time + 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($t) = (time + 1));

=== fork, bare
my $p = fork;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($p) = fork);

=== __FILE__ under print
print __FILE__;
--- facts
faithful
# print(__FILE__);

=== __LINE__ before a concatenation
my $l = __LINE__ . "x";
--- facts
faithful
# (my($l) = '1x');

=== __PACKAGE__ as print's first argument
print __PACKAGE__, "x";
--- facts
faithful
# print(__PACKAGE__, 'x');

=== __PACKAGE__ as an invocant
my $o = __PACKAGE__->can("x");
--- facts
faithful
# (my($o) = __PACKAGE__->can('x'));

=== wantarray in a return
sub f { return wantarray ? @a : $a[0] }
--- facts
faithful
# sub f {
#     (return (wantarray ? @a : $a[0]));
# }

=== a user call before or
sub foo; foo 1 or die;
--- facts
faithful
# (foo(1) or die);
# sub foo ;

=== a user call before a comma in parens
sub foo; my @x = (foo(1), 2);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@x) = (foo(1), 2));
# sub foo ;

=== a user call written bare as the right side of an assignment
sub foo; my @x = foo 1, 2;
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@x) = foo(1, 2));
# sub foo ;

=== time before a comma under print
print time, "x";
--- facts
faithful
# print(time, 'x');

=== a call with its parens before a fat comma
sub foo {7} my @a = (foo() => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# sub foo {
#     7;
# }
# (my(@a) = (foo(), 1));

=== a word before a fat comma
sub foo {7} my @a = (foo => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# sub foo {
#     7;
# }
# (my(@a) = ('foo', 1));

=== a method call with its parens
my $r = Foo->can("x")->(1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my($r) = 'Foo'->can('x')->(1));

=== open before or die
open my $fh, "<", $f or die "no: $!";
--- facts
faithful
# (open(my $fh, '<', $f) or die(("no: $!")));

=== join as the last argument of push
push @a, join ",", @b;
--- facts
faithful
# push(@a, join(',', @b));

=== printf with a list op argument
printf "%s\n", join " ", map { "<$_>" } @a;
--- facts
faithful
# printf("%s\n", join(' ', map({("<$_>");} @a)));

=== a trailing comma before =
substr $x, 0, 1, = "a";
--- facts
faithful
# substr($x, 0, 1) = 'a';

=== a trailing comma before .=
substr $x, 0, 1, .= "a";
--- facts
faithful
# (substr($x, 0, 1) .= 'a');

=== a trailing comma before ||=
substr $x, 0, 1, ||= "a";
--- facts
faithful
# (substr($x, 0, 1) ||= 'a');

=== a trailing comma before &&=
substr $x, 0, 1, &&= "a";
--- facts
faithful
# (substr($x, 0, 1) &&= 'a');

=== a trailing comma before ==
my $b = substr $x, 0, 1, == 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($b) = (substr($x, 0, 1) == 1));

=== a trailing comma before ||
substr $x, 0, 1, || die;
--- facts
faithful
# (substr($x, 0, 1) or die);

=== a trailing comma before or
close $fh, or die;
--- facts
faithful
# (close($fh) or die);

=== a trailing comma before a modifier
sub skip; skip "x", 2, if $m;
--- facts
faithful
# skip('x', 2) if $m;
# sub skip ;

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before minus
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) - 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() - 1));

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before plus
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) + 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() + 1));

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before **
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) ** 2;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() ** 2));

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before <
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) < 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() < 1));

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before < in a condition
sub foo {} if ((foo) < 1) {}
--- facts
faithful
# if ((foo() < 1)) {
#     ();

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before /
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) / 2;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() / 2));

=== a parenthesised zero-argument call before x
sub foo {} my $x = (foo) x 2;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (foo() x 2));

=== a parenthesised qualified zero-argument call before minus
sub Foo::bar {} my $x = (Foo::bar) - 1;
--- facts
faithful
# (my($x) = (Foo::bar() - 1));

=== ucfirst over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((ucfirst foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (ucfirst(foo()), 1));

=== defined over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((defined foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (defined(foo()), 1));

=== ref over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((ref foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (ref(foo()), 1));

=== lc over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((lc foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (lc(foo()), 1));

=== chr over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((chr foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (chr(foo()), 1));

=== length over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((length foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (length(foo()), 1));

=== rand over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((rand foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (rand(foo()), 1));

=== a filetest over a call before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((-e foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = ((-e foo()), 1));

=== lc over time before a fat comma
my %h = ((lc time) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = (lc(time), 1));

=== ucfirst over a call at a right operand before a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = ((1 + ucfirst foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my(%h) = ((1 + ucfirst(foo())), 1));

=== ucfirst over a call before a fat comma in an anon hash
sub foo {} my $h = {(ucfirst foo) => 1};
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my($h) = {ucfirst(foo()), 1});

=== ucfirst over a call before a fat comma in an anon array
sub foo {} my $a = [(ucfirst foo) => 1];
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# (my($a) = [ucfirst(foo()), 1]);

=== ucfirst over a call before a fat comma in call arguments
sub foo {} print((ucfirst foo) => 1);
--- facts
faithful
known-defect 01a1664d-75d4-76eb-aad2-10b322f366a9
# print(ucfirst(foo()), 1);

=== a bare ucfirst operand quoted by a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = (ucfirst foo => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(%h) = ('Foo', 1));

=== a bare defined operand quoted by a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = (defined foo => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(%h) = (1, 1));

=== a bare lc operand quoted by a fat comma
my %h = (lc time => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(%h) = ('time', 1));

=== a bare ucfirst operand at a right operand quoted by a fat comma
sub foo {} my %h = (1 + ucfirst foo => 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(%h) = ((1 + 'Foo'), 1));
